note:
Trial 24 ended in death.

**Outcome:** The screen shows "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the chat line "angelasq was slain by Husk".

**What happened visually:**
- At start a single husk stood on a hilltop directly ahead. I advanced and jumped up the slope.
- Health was already down to about five hearts by the third screenshot, with the husk right beside me on the right edge of the view. The hunger bar also appeared mostly empty with a status icon in the corner, consistent with the husk's hunger effect.
- My turn-and-attack swing missed. The husk was no longer in frame and health had fallen to two hearts.
- While turning further with the shield raised, the trial ended with the death screen.

**Input problems:** None observed. Camera turns and key holds registered as expected. The loss came from the husk reaching melee range while I was still climbing and from under-turning on the first attack, so the swing did not land.
